subject.title: Feature Request: Skill-Driven Plugin Context Visibility (activates.plugins)

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `metadata.openclaw.activates.plugins` skill contract for per-turn plugin tool visibility, or should broad catalog compaction stay owned by Tool Search and static tool policy?
rationale: This changes public skill metadata and request-time tool visibility semantics across skills, plugin tooling, prompt assembly, and security policy; source inspection shows no existing contract to extend mechanically without choosing the product/API direction first.

options.title: Approve activation design
options.body: Define the `activates.plugins` semantics, precedence, and compatibility rules before implementation, then land the parser, snapshot, tool-planning, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Defer to Tool Search
options.body: Keep this issue open only as context for Tool Search improvements if maintainers prefer catalog search over skill-driven plugin activation.

options.title: Fold into broader skill graph work
options.body: Merge the product decision into a broader skill-dependency or context-loading design so related open proposals do not create competing contracts.

recommendation.title: Approve activation design
recommendation.body: Define the `activates.plugins` semantics, precedence, and compatibility rules before implementation, then land the parser, snapshot, tool-planning, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent history routes through agent tool assembly and skill-loading surfaces touched by this API decision, and the decision spans product/runtime boundaries.
